title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
partTitle: Submitting Ourselves to the Lordship of Jesus
partTitleZh: 順服主權，拒絕信仰自助餐
summaryZh: 凡不在耶穌主權下的領域都在神國之外，我們不可隨感覺過自助餐式的基督徒生活。
lines: When the Kingdom of God comes into a person's mind, their thinking becomes orderly, clear, and reflects Christ.
當神的國進入一個人的心思中，他們的思維就變得有條理、清晰，並彰顯出基督。
Would you agree with me on this?
OK, so when the lordship of Jesus comes into someone's mind, it's the same thing.
好，所以當耶穌的主權進入某人的心思時，也是同一回事。
It's the same concept, just different terminology.
這是相同的概念，只是用語不同。
Any part of my life that is not subject to the lordship of Jesus is outside the Kingdom.
我生命中凡不順服耶穌主權的任何部分，都在神的國之外。
Any part of my life that is not under the authority of Jesus.
也就是我生命中任何未在耶穌權柄之下的部分。
You know, the Lord's power is measurable.
你知道的，主的大能是可以衡量的。
Any part of my life outside of Jesus' authority is outside the Kingdom.
我生命中任何在耶穌權柄之外的部分，都在神的國之外。
The problem is that we have realms outside the Kingdom, so to speak, and we constantly ask God to bless what is outside the Kingdom.
問題在於，可以說我們在神的國之外還有其他領域，而我們卻不斷求神賜福那些在神的國之外的事物。
Blessings naturally come to all that He rules over.
祝福自然會臨到祂所掌管的一切。
To ask Him to bless that which is outside the Kingdom is to ask Him to affirm our independence from Him.
求祂賜福那在神的國之外的事物，就是求祂肯定我們脫離祂的獨立性。
去認可、並且贊同這種獨立。
Although all He does is lead us to a place of constant presence and continuous devotion.
儘管祂所做的一切，都是要引導我們進入一個持續有祂同在、不斷委身之處。
One of the most important things that I think is seriously neglected in our time is the common gathering.
我認為在我們這個時代被嚴重忽略的最重要事情之一，就是共同聚會。
I'm not trying to—you know, I'm grateful, but I need you to hear me.
我不是想要——你知道的，我很感恩，但我需要你們聽我說。
In the Christian life, much of what we do is a Christian buffet.
在基督徒的生活中，我們所做的很多事都成了一場基督徒自助餐。
This is a Christian buffet: "Well, I can take it this week."
這是一場基督徒自助餐：「嗯，這週我可以領受這個。」
And in the Christian life, this sort of sorting happens, where we adjust our values every week depending on how we feel at the moment.
在基督徒的生活中，常會出現這種挑三揀四的情況，我們每週都根據當下的感覺來調整自己的價值觀。
We make all these decisions that are not based on values.
我們做出的這一切決定，都不是基於價值觀。
They are not based on the covenant values we have placed before the Lord.
它們並非基於我們在主面前所立定的聖約價值觀。
They are actually based on what we are feeling in the moment.
它們實際上只是基於我們當下的感覺。
Then Jesus does not become Lord.
那麼耶穌就沒有成為主。
And there are certain things that need to be established in our lives and in our routines so that we can properly educate students and create momentum for the next generation.
在我們的生活和日常作息中，有些事情必須確立起來，這樣我們才能妥善地教導學生，並為下一代建立動能。
Come on, let's just move on.
Did I tell you where to go?
我有告訴你們要翻到哪裡嗎？
How many of you heard what I said?
你們當中有多少人聽到了我說的話？
